component: EC124 Liquid Air Energy Storage (LAES / CES)
description: Physics-lumped LAES: charge = air liquefaction (specific liquefaction work, Claude/Linde cycle); store = cryogenic liquid-air tank with boil-off heat ingress (0D thermal/mass ODE); discharge = cryo-pump -> evaporate (cold recycle + waste-heat superheat) -> turbine expansion. RTE 50-60% (higher with cold/hot recycle).
source: Morgan, R., Nelmes, S., Gibson, E., Brett, G. (2015), Applied Energy 137, 845-853 (Highview pilot plant); Guizzi, G.L., Manno, M., Tolomei, L.M., Vitali, R.M. (2015), Energy 93(1), 1382-1394; Sciacovelli, A., Vecchi, A., Ding, Y. (2017), Applied Energy 190, 84-98; Highview Power CRYOBattery technical data.

unit.name: Generic Stand-alone LAES (Highview-class), 1500 t liquid-air tank

specific_liquefaction_kwh_per_kg.note: Electrical work to liquefy air, Claude/Linde cycle (~0.36-0.50). Morgan 2015 pilot ~0.40-0.45 kWh/kg.

w_liq_floor_kwh_per_kg.note: Minimum (ideal-cold-recycle) liquefaction work; reversible isothermal limit ~0.2 kWh/kg air. Used as lower bound when cold recycle perfect.

eta_liquefier.note: Compressor/motor drive-train mechanical efficiency on charge

specific_exergy_liquid_kwh_per_kg.note: Usable specific shaft work of the discharge train (cryo-pump pressurisation + cold-recycled evaporation + expansion) per kg liquid air, before pump/expander/generator efficiencies. ~0.27-0.29 kWh/kg; physical exergy floor of liquid air is ~0.205 kWh/kg (739 kJ/kg, Guizzi 2015 / Ameel 2013), cold recycle to the high-pressure air stream raises usable expansion work.

T_storage.note: Saturated liquid air at ~1 atm (between N2 77.4 K and O2 90.2 K)

rho_liquid_air.note: Liquid air density ~0.87 g/cm3 at 78 K (Vecchi 2021)

cp_gas_air_kJ_kgK.note: Gaseous air cp at near-ambient (ideal-gas value)

h_vap_air_kJ_kg.note: Latent heat of vaporisation of air ~199-213 kJ/kg at 1 atm (N2 199, O2 213)

UA_tank_W_per_K.note: Overall tank heat-leak conductance (vacuum/perlite insulated 1500 t tank). Tuned so BOR(298K) ~0.5%/day.

cold_recycle_eff_ref.note: Cold recycle effectiveness: fraction of stored cold (high-grade) recovered to assist next liquefaction. Highview/Sciacovelli ~0.5-0.7.

hot_recycle_dT_K.note: Default no external/waste heat. If >0, superheats air before turbine (raises discharge work).

T_superheat_max_K.note: Max turbine inlet temperature with waste-heat integration

P_charge_rated_kW.note: Rated charging (liquefier) electrical power, ~50 MW class
